INSERT INTO custom_providers (id, name, base_url, env_var, seed_models)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
             ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
               name        = EXCLUDED.name,
               base_url    = EXCLUDED.base_url,
               env_var     = EXCLUDED.env_var,
               seed_models = EXCLUDED.seed_models
